question_text: Write a summary of the above passage in your own words.
guide_solution: Abul Kashem Fazlul Huq, one of the greatest politicians, was born at Saturia in Barishal. After completing his education, he started his career as an examiner in Calcutta University. He made an important role in founding "All India Muslim League" in 1906. He was elected as a member of BLC in 1913. In 1918, A.K. Fazlul Huq became the General Secretary of the Indian Congress and was the President of All India Muslim League.
